text: {"claims": [{"context": "general mammalian cells, cited from other work", "effect": "activates", "evidence_quote": "When replication forks stall, the extension of single-stranded DNA and the coating of RPA trigger activation of ataxia-telangiectasia and Rad3-related (ATR) kinase and DDR (4,5).", "location": "INTRODUCTION", "source": "single-stranded DNA", "target": "ATR"}, {"context": "mammals, persistent RPA-coated ssDNA filaments, cited from other work", "effect": "activates", "evidence_quote": "On the other hand, the presence of persistent RPA-coated ssDNA filaments upon replication stress or stalled replication forks will lead to recruitment of the ATR-ATRIP (ATR-interacting protein) complex, activation of the ATR signaling pathway and DDR (4,5).", "location": "DISCUSSION", "source": "replication stress", "target": "ATR"}, {"context": "mammals, persistent RPA-coated ssDNA filaments, cited from other work", "effect": "activates", "evidence_quote": "On the other hand, the presence of persistent RPA-coated ssDNA filaments upon replication stress or stalled replication forks will lead to recruitment of the ATR-ATRIP (ATR-interacting protein) complex, activation of the ATR signaling pathway and DDR (4,5).", "location": "DISCUSSION", "source": "stalled replication forks", "target": "ATR"}]}
